data._comment_source_format: auto: '.pt' path -> wenoa_pt, directory -> npz_bundle. You can also force 'npz_bundle' or 'wenoa_pt'.
data._comment_wenoa_path: For WENO-A, set data_dir to a .pt file (or provide data.wenoa_pt_path).
data._comment_regime_filter: For bundled dataset: 'all' | 'inviscid' | 'viscous'. For WENO-A this applies to synthetic nu (default nu=0 unless data.wenoa_nu is set).
data._comment_wenoa_nu: Optional for WENO-A only: set numeric data.wenoa_nu (e.g., 0.0, 0.001) if you need regime_filter behavior.

input_features._comment_use_pos: For source_format='wenoa_pt': feature_columns are ignored and effective features are ['u'] or ['x','u'] depending on use_pos.

physics_inputs._comment_adv_normalization: If normalize_adv_to_minus1_1 is true and adv_min/adv_max are not provided, train script fits adv_min/adv_max from train-split advection percentiles and stores them in checkpoint config.
physics_inputs._comment_adv_percentiles: Percentile bounds used to fit adv_min/adv_max (set to 0 and 100 to recover old pure min/max behavior).
